name: Vastrm
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Burlingame, CA, USA; Remote
long_description:
Vastrm Fashion™ (pronounced vas' trum) Vastrm was started to solve a basic problem: Shirts that don’t fit well!

Mass produced shirts were meant to accommodate a wide variety of body types with one standard size, and different brands have different sizing standards, making shopping difficult--many men must shop in 4 - 5 different stores before finding a shirt that actually fits! By providing a home try on program and giving the ability to make custom fit adjustments to all of their apparel, Vastrm allows its customers to finally hone in on and find the perfect fit for their unique body types.

Tang came up with the idea for Vastrm, which is a Sanskrit word for cloth, when a customer told him he had purchased a perfect shirt in Italy and has never been able to find the same fit again. He was considering flying back to Italy to track the shirt maker down, but Jonathan managed to adjust Vastrm shirts to the same fit.

TLDR: At PatternFast we make it quick, inexpensive and painless for fashion companies and brands to design, develop and release new styles and collections.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84021&key=user_uploads/275448/2a022106-b166-4c05-87e5-a52d71f1d398)

\
**The Problem: designing and developing fashion is very long, difficult, complex and expensive.** \
Designing and developing fashion is extremely difficult. Each step involves long and tedious work: sketching a design, creating a tech pack, drafting and fitting an initial pattern, making a sample, adjusting the pattern after fitting on a model (typically 2-3 fittings), modifying the pattern to fit specific fabrics, grading the pattern to fit all sizes, measuring each point of the pattern, making a pre-production tech pack, sewing a final sample, and finally taking pictures. The process is exceptionally complex, wasteful, expensive, and time-consuming, averaging over 92 hours per style. It costs brands $70,000 per 5 new styles on average. Some collections have more than a 1000 styles, costing brands millions of dollars and many months to complete.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84021&key=user_uploads/275448/f68e3c78-590d-4a35-acb2-db94e30b7c01)

\
\*\*The Solution: AI that assists design, product development and prepares for production; and creates photos of new fashion styles in minutes, not months.\*\*\
PatternFast helps fashion companies and brands design and launch new collections in minutes instead of months. We save brands 90% of the time and 95% of the costs associated with the tedious, time-consuming, and complex process of garment design and development. Our AI software enables the instant design of over hundred billion of unique styles, complete with production-ready documentation, patterns, and automated sizing.\
\
In just a few clicks, PatternFast creates new designs for women, men, children and teens. It also:

2. Customizes sizes for made-to-measure retail and manufacturing, and provides a full size run for mass production, based on the brand’s size run.
3. Enables smart pattern adjustments to work with any fabric, perfects fit, adds automated seam allowances, accounts for shrinkage and compression, and adjusts for stretch factor.
4. Generates a tech pack with all of the pattern measurements for each selected size.
5. AI designer creates infinite new designs based on the user input and both, unique brand’s pattern dataset, combined with billions of available patterns to mix and match.
6. AI designer creates instant color-ways and print-ways.
7. Gen-AI creates a photorealistic image of the sketch and puts it on a model for a catalog image
8. Custom API integrates with other solutions.
9. Patterns are compatible with third party solutions such as Browzwear, CLO3D, Gerber and many others.
